LESSON: BUSINESS PLAN

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.3: Business Plan

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Business Plan. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Business Plan
2. Practise Business Plan at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Business Plan

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Business Plan
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Business Plan. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Business Plan at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Business Plan at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Business Plan
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Business Plan. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Business Plan using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Business Plan in the examples.
2. Explain Business Plan to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Business Plan.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Business Plan using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Business Plan important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Business Plan
2. Practise Business Plan at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Business Plan

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
